label: Australia federates
description: The six Australian colonies federate as the Commonwealth of Australia in January 1901.

label: Union of South Africa
description: The Cape, Natal, Transvaal and Orange River colonies unite as the Union of South Africa, a dominion, on 31 May 1910.

label: Egypt and Cyprus
description: On the outbreak of war with the Ottoman Empire, Britain proclaims a protectorate over Egypt (December 1914) and annexes Cyprus.

label: Mandates allocated
description: Former German and Ottoman territories become League of Nations mandates, including Palestine (allocated at San Remo, April 1920), Iraq and Tanganyika.

label: Irish Free State; Egypt
description: Britain ends its protectorate over Egypt (28 February 1922), and the Irish Free State is established as a dominion in December 1922.

label: Statute of Westminster
description: The Statute of Westminster (11 December 1931) gives the dominions legislative equality with Britain. On this map, Canada, South Africa and the Irish Free State stop counting as British.

label: India and Pakistan
description: India and Pakistan become independent dominions on 15 August 1947 under the Indian Independence Act.

label: Burma, Ceylon, Palestine
description: Burma becomes independent in January 1948 and Ceylon on 4 February; the Palestine mandate ends with British withdrawal in May.

label: Ghana and Malaya
description: Ghana (6 March 1957) and the Federation of Malaya (31 August 1957) become independent.

label: Nigeria, Cyprus, Somaliland
description: British Somaliland (26 June), Cyprus (16 August) and Nigeria (1 October) become independent in 1960.

label: Rhodesia's UDI
description: Southern Rhodesia's white minority government declares independence on 11 November 1965. Britain does not recognise it, and legally the territory remains British until 1980.

label: Hong Kong handover
description: Hong Kong returns to Chinese sovereignty on 1 July 1997.
